Healthcare and insurance costs are high. Education is both more expensive and more necessary than in previous generations. Outsourcing, automation, and efficiency have shifted the rule of supply and demand in favor of the employer and to the detriment of the employee. Job security has diminished, and so has the concept of the valued employee. Gone are the days when you could graduate high school, pay your way through college with a summer job, and expect to own a house, two cars, and start saving a nest egg as a young adult.

What's more interesting to me is that Millennials are the connected generation.
